jobs.title: Data Scientist - Personalisation
jobs.snippet: Build dashboards for performance visibility, conduct exploratory data analysis, and partner with ML engineers to take models from prototype to production in the Personalisation team.
jobs.description:
## About

Canva's Personalisation team is building AI and ML-powered systems that help users explore Canva's design platform more effectively, connecting them to the most relevant content to design faster and better.

## Responsibilities

- Build dashboards for performance visibility and experimentation readiness
- Conduct exploratory data analysis to surface insights for product decisions
- Partner with ML engineers to take models from prototype to production
- Collaborate with product managers, analytics engineers, and ML engineers to shape personalisation strategy
- Drive A/B testing frameworks and measure the impact of personalisation features on engagement and retention

## Requirements

- Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
- Experience with data analysis, statistical modelling, and machine learning
- Familiarity with ML model deployment and productionisation workflows
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills
- Experience with data visualisation and dashboarding tools
- Background in recommendation systems or user personalisation preferred

## Tech Stack

Python, SQL, Spark, Databricks, dbt, Looker, PyTorch/TensorFlow

## Benefits

Hybrid working model (Tues–Thurs in office), competitive salary, equity, health benefits, Canva Premium subscription, learning and development budget.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - MLOps
jobs.snippet: Join Entain's Data Science team developing and improving end-to-end ML operations and technical solutions enabling Data Science projects across customer behaviour, finance, responsible gambling, fraud identification and risk pricing.
jobs.description:
## About

Entain Australia & New Zealand is on a mission to revolutionise the world of sports and gaming venue entertainment, with leading brands including Ladbrokes Australia and neds. The Data Science team is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer with MLOps expertise to enable scalable, production-grade ML across the business.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and improve end-to-end ML operations and technical solutions that enable Data Science projects
- Build and maintain ML pipelines across customer behaviour, finance, responsible gambling, fraud identification and risk pricing domains
- Manage ML model lifecycle including deployment, monitoring, retraining and versioning
- Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models using Databricks and AWS
- Collaborate with Data Scientists to productionise models and ensure reproducibility
- Monitor model performance in production and trigger retraining workflows

## Requirements

- Experience in the full lifecycle of productionising, deploying and maintaining commercial-grade ML models in cloud environments (Databricks, AWS)
- Strong Python and SQL skills
- Familiarity with MLflow, Airflow, or similar orchestration tools
- Experience with model monitoring and observability frameworks
- Knowledge of containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) preferred

## Tech Stack

Python, SQL, Databricks, AWS, MLflow, Docker, Airflow

## Benefits

9-day fortnight for work-life balance, 12 weeks paid parental leave, fully remote within Australia option, subsidised gym memberships, free onsite barista and fully stocked fridge and pantry.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Develop and deploy cutting-edge ML and AI solutions at Entain Group, designing and implementing advanced machine learning algorithms to solve complex business problems in sports and gaming entertainment.
jobs.description:
## About

Entain Australia & New Zealand, home to leading sports betting brands Ladbrokes Australia and neds, is hiring a Data Scientist to drive ML innovation across their business. You will work in a collaborative Data Science team to deliver high-impact solutions in a fast-paced entertainment environment.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and deploy cutting-edge ML and AI solutions to drive business outcomes
- Design and implement advanced machine learning algorithms to solve complex business problems
- Communicate findings clearly to stakeholders and collaborate with cross-functional teams
- Deliver scalable AI solutions across responsible gambling, customer analytics, risk and pricing
- Partner with MLOps engineers to move models from experimentation to production
- Analyse large datasets to identify trends and build predictive models

## Requirements

- Experience in Data Science or a similar role
- Proficiency in Python and SQL programming languages
- Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals and model evaluation techniques
- Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex findings for non-technical audiences
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) preferred

## Tech Stack

Python, SQL, Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, scikit-learn, XGBoost

## Benefits

9-day fortnight, 12 weeks paid parental leave, wellness benefits including heavily subsidised gym memberships, remote working flexibility within Australia, office locations in Brisbane (HQ), Sydney and Melbourne.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: Build scalable data pipelines in Snowflake and AWS, enabling real-time analytics across ANZ for Entain Group brands including Ladbrokes Australia and neds.
jobs.description:
## About

Entain Group is seeking a Data Engineer to build and scale the data infrastructure that powers advanced analytics and AI/ML capabilities across their ANZ operations. Join a team delivering data-driven insights for Australia's leading sports betting and entertainment brands.

## Responsibilities

- Build and maintain scalable data pipelines in Snowflake and AWS
- Enable real-time analytics across ANZ brands including Ladbrokes Australia and neds
- Design and implement data warehouse schemas to support business intelligence and ML use cases

## Requirements

- Strong experience with Snowflake, AWS data services (Glue, S3, Redshift) and Python

Snowflake, AWS (S3, Glue, Kinesis, Redshift), Airflow, dbt, Python, SQL

## Benefits

9-day fortnight, 12 weeks paid parental leave, remote within Australia, wellness benefits, subsidised gym memberships.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: Build Microsoft Fabric data solutions, optimise analytics, support Power BI, and drive AI-led insights across Service Stream's infrastructure and maintenance operations.
jobs.description:
## About

Service Stream is a leading provider of infrastructure and maintenance services across Australia, supporting essential sectors including telecommunications, utilities, and transport. The Data Engineering team is building next-generation data platforms to enable AI-led decision-making and enterprise analytics.

## Responsibilities

- Design and build Microsoft Fabric data solutions for enterprise-scale analytics
- Optimise data pipelines and analytics workloads for performance and scalability
- Support Power BI reporting and self-service analytics capabilities across the business
- Drive AI-led insights initiatives by enabling ML-ready data products and feature stores
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate data requirements into robust engineering solutions
- Ensure data governance, quality and security standards are maintained

## Requirements

- Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, or similar modern data platforms
- Proficiency in SQL, Python, and Power BI development
- Hands-on experience with data modelling, ETL/ELT pipeline development
- Understanding of AI/ML data requirements and feature engineering practices
- Experience with Azure DevOps for CI/CD of data pipelines
- Azure certifications (DP-203 or DP-700) preferred

## Tech Stack

Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Power BI, SQL, Python, Azure DevOps, dbt

## Benefits

Hybrid working arrangements (Melbourne office), professional development and certification support, competitive salary, employee wellbeing programs, access to national infrastructure projects.

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师
jobs.snippet: 负责大模型（LLM）核心算法研发，包括预训练、指令微调（SFT）、RLHF、对齐优化，探索MoE稀疏化等前沿模型结构。2027届AIDU提前批7月开启。
jobs.description:
## 关于百度 AIDU 计划

百度AIDU计划面向全球顶尖AI技术人才，2027届提前批网申时间为2026年7月8日至2026年9月29日。招聘目标为2027届博士生及优秀硕士生，方向涵盖大模型算法、多模态算法、智能体、自动驾驶、AI异构计算等。

## 职位职责

- 负责大模型（LLM）核心算法研发，涵盖预训练、指令微调（SFT）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、对齐优化与推理增强
- 探索高效的模型调优策略及高质量数据建设方法
- 研究前沿模型结构，如MoE稀疏化、Latent Attention，推动模型性能突破
- 将算法研究成果落地为产品级应用，与工程团队协同

## 任职要求

- 2027届博士或优秀硕士应届生（毕业时间2026年9月1日至2027年8月31日）
- 扎实的机器学习和深度学习理论基础
- 熟悉PyTorch或TensorFlow等主流深度学习框架
- 有顶会（NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL等）论文发表经验者优先
- 有LLM预训练、后训练或推理优化实际经验者优先

## 技术栈

Python, PyTorch, CUDA, 分布式训练（FSDP / Megatron-LM）, RLHF框架

## 待遇

有竞争力的薪酬包（硕士起薪约35-45万元/年），提供国际化研究环境及顶尖导师资源，百度内推直通渠道。

jobs.title: AI模型工程师实习生
jobs.snippet: 华为AI实习生专项计划，AI模型工程师方向包括多模态/语言/边缘大模型、大模型后训练与强化学习、空间智能及Agent技术。全年开放，北京。
jobs.description:

华为面向全球高校在读本科、硕士、博士生启动AI实习生专项计划（不限专业），重点招募具备人工智能相关研究或项目背景的人才，全年开放投递，鼓励长期深度参与（6个月以上优先）。

## AI模型工程师方向职责

- 参与多模态大模型、语言大模型或边缘端大模型的算法研究与工程实现
- 负责大模型后训练（SFT、RLHF、DPO）及强化学习相关算法开发
- 探索空间智能（3D感知、机器人）及Agent技术的产品化落地
- 构建AI算法评测体系，持续优化大模型能力与安全性
- 与昇腾（Ascend）硬件团队协同，进行模型适配与优化

## 任职要求

- 在读本科（大三及以上）、硕士或博士研究生，不限专业
- 扎实的深度学习理论基础和动手实践能力
- 熟悉PyTorch或MindSpore框架
- 有顶会论文或参与过开源大模型项目（LLaMA, Qwen, GLM等）者优先
- 实习时间不少于3个月

## 工作地点

北京（另有深圳、上海、杭州、南京、西安、武汉、成都、苏州等城市岗位开放）

## 技术栈

Python, PyTorch, MindSpore, CUDA, 分布式训练, RLHF框架

## 待遇

有竞争力的实习工资，优秀实习生可获转正机会，享受华为完善的培训与发展体系及导师制度。

jobs.description:

华为AI实习生专项计划下的AI Infra工程师方向，专注于大模型工程化基础设施建设，支撑百亿至千亿参数规模的模型训练与推理部署工程化。

- 掌握CUDA/C++编程，了解GPU/NPU体系结构

- 协同算法、工程团队完成需求落地，参与A/B测试与数据驱动优化
- 持续跟踪行业竞品与技术趋势，输出高质量产品方案与竞争策略

## 任职要求

- 2026届应届本科或硕士毕业生
- 对AI产品及大模型技术充满热情
- 对LLM预训练、微调、RLHF、RAG等底层技术有基础理解
- 具备较强的产品思维、数据分析能力和逻辑表达能力
- 有互联网产品、数据分析或算法相关实习经验者优先

## 培训与发展

- AI Campus智能化知识问答与职业发展辅助
- 10,000+实习岗位生态，优先内部转岗机会

有竞争力的校招薪酬，提供腾讯全套员工福利（六险一金、年终奖、股权激励计划）。

jobs.title: 推荐模型算法工程师
jobs.snippet: 快手推荐模型部招募推荐模型算法工程师，负责生成式推荐、大模型应用及推荐系统技术研究与落地。计算机/数学/统计学本科及以上。北京。
jobs.description:
## 关于快手

快手科技是中国领先的短视频和直播平台，月活用户超6亿。推荐模型部招募有经验的推荐模型算法工程师，聚焦生成式推荐与大模型在推荐系统中的融合应用。

## 职位职责

- 负责生成式推荐系统的算法研究与工程实现，探索大模型（LLM）与传统推荐系统的融合应用
- 开发并优化推荐模型，覆盖召回、粗排、精排全链路
- 参与模型工程化部署与在线效果追踪，持续优化推荐指标（CTR、时长、留存等）
- 开展A/B实验分析，数据驱动推荐策略迭代
- 探索多模态内容理解在推荐系统中的应用

## 任职要求

- 计算机、数学、统计学相关专业本科及以上
- 扎实的机器学习和深度学习基础，熟悉推荐系统主流方法
- 熟悉推荐系统、搜索或广告相关技术方向
- 熟练掌握Python和TensorFlow/PyTorch
- 有工业界大规模推荐系统实战经验者优先

## 技术栈

Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Spark, HDFS, Faiss, HBase, 实时流处理

## 待遇

有竞争力的薪酬（含股票期权），弹性工作制，完善福利体系，鼓励创新的技术氛围。

jobs.title: 广告算法工程师
jobs.snippet: 快手商业化算法客户机制中心招募广告算法工程师，负责广告出价、外循环广告模型研发与优化。硕士及以上，有顶会论文发表者优先。北京。
jobs.description:
## 关于岗位

快手商业化算法客户机制中心及外循环广告模型团队2026年暑期实习及日常招募，岗位聚焦广告出价算法与生成式推荐融合，以及大模型在计算广告中的应用。

## 职位职责

- 负责广告出价算法设计与优化，提升广告收益与用户体验平衡
- 参与外循环广告模型的研发，探索大模型（LLM）在广告系统中的应用
- 开发和优化CTR/CVR预估模型，提升广告转化效率
- 分析用户行为数据，建立广告效果归因模型和实验分析框架
- 进行在线A/B测试，持续迭代优化广告算法策略

## 任职要求

- 硕士及以上学历，博士优先
- 计算机、统计学、数学等相关专业
- 有机器学习、深度学习、计算广告相关研究或工业界实践经验
- 在ICML、KDD、AAAI、IJCAI、ICLR、SIGIR等顶会以第一作者发表论文者优先
- 熟悉Python和大数据处理工具（Spark、Hive等）

## 技术栈

Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, Spark, Hive, HDFS, 实时计算框架

## 待遇

有竞争力的薪酬（含股票期权），弹性工作安排，团队技术氛围浓厚，快手年活用户超7亿的广告系统规模带来的独特技术挑战。
